name: update_process_packet_BL
notes: Update mode: handles one 32-byte 'UO' HID packet (C1 erase, C2 write, C3 finish, C4 version).

name: oled_clear_page_BL
notes: Clears one 128-byte page (0-4) of the OLED buffer.

name: usb_send_report_BL
notes: USB send: (endpoint, data, length); replies 'UI' on endpoint 0x81.

name: bootloader_main_BL
notes: Boot decision: app marker + SHIFT/PROG SELECT; update mode loop (docs/bootloader.md).

name: screensaver_update_APP
notes: UI idle state machine (state at 0x20004DA6): 1 temporary screen (boot or message, timeout in 0x20000000), 2 normal, 3 screensaver. After 15000001 ticks of 20 us (5 min) without activity draws bitmap_akai_logo_APP, then swaps normal/inverted every 250001 ticks (5 s).

name: draw_bitmap_APP
notes: draw_bitmap(x, y, bitmap, invert): bitmap = [width, height] then ceil(height/8) bytes per column, LSB = top; into the column-major framebuffer (4 bytes per column).

name: display_test_APP
notes: Endless loop: logo inverted, logo, all off, all on. Factory display test (power-up key combination?).

name: hid_process_packet_APP
notes: Application HID handler: answers a 'UO' C4 packet with 'UI' E4 and ignores everything else (tells update tools the bootloader is not running).

name: bitmap_akai_logo_APP
notes: Screensaver bitmap, 128x32: header 80 20, then 512 bytes, 4 per column. Replaced by tools/screensaver.py.

name: __iar_data_init3
notes: IAR runtime: runs the RAM initialisers from a table.

name: __iar_program_start
notes: IAR runtime entry, called by Reset_Handler.
